title: ExecutableEncoding
description: Polymorphic typed reference to an executable encoding of a Term or Obligation. Lets a Term point at a Catala scope, a Blawx ruleset, an OpenFisca formula, etc., without privileging any one engine.

kind.description: The execution engine the encoding targets. 'other' is allowed for engines not yet in the closed vocabulary; v0.x may expand the enum without breaking changes.

uri.description: IRI of the encoding artifact (a Catala scope, a Blawx project, etc.).

version.description: Optional version of the encoding (e.g., a git tag or semver string). Pinning is recommended for reproducibility.

engine_version.description: Optional version of the execution engine the encoding requires.
